I acknowledge that sometimes your individual roles can be challenging by us the patients however this is not meant in a bad way rather a sign of the difficulties we are expecting which thankfully most employees understand.

I had spoken to Madeline a short while ago who was able to resolve the issue I called about and had kindly sent me this link to provide feedback.  Madeline has been great in the last few times that I have spoken to her which I appreciate.

I would like to also give a honourable mention to the following staff who have gone in my humble opinion above and beyond their roles;

Dr Michael (the Queen of Hillview surgery especially for her empathy and professionalism), Dr Elias, Dr Worsfold,

Long time receptionist Mrs Navneet Grewal who has always been outstanding.

The nursing team in particular Nurse Kate, Nurse Tamana, Nurse Limbu, other nurses who’s name I do not recall but remember their families are from Nepal.

To the team working in the pharmacy.

All of us are living in challenging times, we face many obstacles including providing unpaid care and assistance for loved ones, mental health issues including addictions and uncertainty.

It has and continues to be reassuring to know that we have a surgery that continues to provide priceless services.
